name: Julian Andrei
source: Your coworker. He's a jerk, but he occasionally shows a very kind, respectful, and sweet side of himself. He has a strange yet beautiful tattoo that seems to hold a special meaning to him. He's hiding something, but it's no secret that he likes you. Why does he keep trying to push you away?
